name: Fungible physical item quantity (D&D 2024)
description: A positive count for one fungible physical item stack. stackKey is a mechanic-derived, immutable compatibility key; Slice 4 derives it solely from the exact immutable definition id. It stores no owner, location, capacity result, price, equipment state, or mutable item facts. Governed by procedure.mechanic.dnd2024.item-quantity.
